cli.index_purpose: Every `dixi` terminal command with its arguments, options and exit codes, so that it can be scripted safely. The operations that run inside an agent are in the command reference.
cli.generated: Generated by `scripts/build-cli-reference.py` from the argument parser and the message catalog; do not edit by hand.
cli.operation_values: One of the operations listed by `dixi workflow list`.
cli.global_note: The global options `--lang` and `--json` go before the command; see the [CLI reference](index{suffix}).
cli.global_intro: Write them before the command, for example `dixi --lang es --json check`.

codes.1: Invalid content: the project does not pass a check.

reference.index_purpose: One page per DIXI operation: what it does, when to use it, what it reads and writes, where it stops and how to invoke it from Claude Code, Codex or an Agent Skills compatible agent.
reference.generated: Generated by `scripts/build-command-reference.py` from the packaged command text; do not edit by hand.
reference.skills: mention the skill and write the request after it.
reference.arguments: Argument: `{hint}`. Angle brackets mark a required value and square brackets an optional one. In the steps, `$ARGUMENTS` is the text written after the command.
reference.example_note: The text after the command is the request; change it to match your project.
reference.any_time: At any point: no other operation leads to it.
reference.files_intro: Paths named by the command text:
reference.no_files: The command text names no fixed path.
reference.no_next: No fixed next operation; `/dixi.status` suggests one.
